rationale: The pain is real and technically well-documented — silent OAuth token expiry in Salesforce 2nd-gen External Credentials is a genuine, time-consuming debugging burden. However, evidence remains a single forum thread with no corroborating signals, no willingness-to-pay evidence for a dedicated monitoring tool, and the affected population (orgs using specifically 2nd-gen External Credentials with Google OAuth) is a narrow technical niche within an already small universe. The pain does not meet the 5-distinct-quote threshold and has zero willingness-to-pay signal beyond the general observation that Salesforce admins use tooling.
